payload.explanation: Diagnostic report identifies the root blocker as session_94801c72ddfa (pid 458), idle in transaction after running the same UPDATE on inventory product_id=1, blocking the business request session_8f6f2dd4b35d on Lock: transactionid; single-hop chain, with large-data/index/vacuum causes ruled out. State report confirms session_94801c72ddfa is eligible for rollback_session (project-owned, not released), while the business session has no allowed actions and must not be modified directly. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock so the decrement can complete; other sessions are preserved.
